attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates New York state income tax per Form IT-201. NY uses a progressive tax system with 9 brackets (4% to 10.9%). Starting with federal AGI, subtracts pension income (up to $20,000), applies standard deduction and dependent exemptions, then applies progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NEW YORK FORM IT-201 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ny_agi xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY tax for single filer; Calculate NY AGI, apply single standard deduction and exemptions, apply progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ ny_pension_subtraction > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq income_type "ira_distribution" streq or if dup gross_amount ny_pension_subtraction f+ local@ ny_pension_subtraction > endif } job.incomes forall ny_pension_subtraction ny_pension_subtraction_max fmin local@ ny_pension_subtraction > ny_pension_subtraction 0 f> if " Subtract Pension Income: -$" ny_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat " (max $20,000)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi ny_pension_subtraction f- /result.ny_agi xdef endif " New York AGI: $" result.ny_agi cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 19)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Standard Deduction (Single): -$" ny_standard_deduction_single cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi ny_standard_deduction_single f- 0 fmax /result.ny_agi_after_deduction xdef job.dependents arraysize local@ num_dependents > num_dependents 0 > if num_dependents ny_dependent_exemption f* /result.ny_dependent_exemption_total xdef " Dependent Exemptions: " num_dependents cvs strconcat " × $" strconcat ny_dependent_exemption cvs strconcat " = -$" strconcat result.ny_dependent_exemption_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi_after_deduction result.ny_dependent_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.ny_taxable_income xdef else result.ny_agi_after_deduction /result.ny_taxable_income xdef endif " New York Taxable Income: $" result.ny_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 33)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto NY_Apply_Tax_Brackets_Single " New York Tax: $" result.ny_tax cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 39)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY tax for married filing jointly; Calculate NY AGI, apply MFJ standard deduction and exemptions, apply progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ ny_pension_subtraction > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq income_type "ira_distribution" streq or if dup gross_amount ny_pension_subtraction f+ local@ ny_pension_subtraction > endif } job.incomes forall ny_pension_subtraction ny_pension_subtraction_max fmin local@ ny_pension_subtraction > ny_pension_subtraction 0 f> if " Subtract Pension Income: -$" ny_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat " (max $20,000)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi ny_pension_subtraction f- /result.ny_agi xdef endif " New York AGI: $" result.ny_agi cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 19)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Standard Deduction (MFJ): -$" ny_standard_deduction_mfj cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi ny_standard_deduction_mfj f- 0 fmax /result.ny_agi_after_deduction xdef job.dependents arraysize local@ num_dependents > num_dependents 0 > if num_dependents ny_dependent_exemption f* /result.ny_dependent_exemption_total xdef " Dependent Exemptions: " num_dependents cvs strconcat " × $" strconcat ny_dependent_exemption cvs strconcat " = -$" strconcat result.ny_dependent_exemption_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ny_agi_after_deduction result.ny_dependent_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.ny_taxable_income xdef else result.ny_agi_after_deduction /result.ny_taxable_income xdef endif " New York Taxable Income: $" result.ny_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 33)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto NY_Apply_Tax_Brackets_MFJ " New York Tax: $" result.ny_tax cvs strconcat " (Form IT-201 Line 39)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
